nodes.summary: The Mandelbrot set is the set $M$ of complex numbers $c$ for which the orbit of $0$ under the quadratic map $T_c(z) = z^2 + c$ is bounded: there is a real number $R$ with $|T_c^n(0)| \le R$ for every $n \in \mathbb{N}$, where $T_c^n$ is the $n$-th iterate of $T_c$ and $T_c^0$ is the identity.
nodes.title: Mandelbrot set

nodes.summary: The boundary of the Mandelbrot set $M \subseteq \mathbb{C}$ has Hausdorff dimension $2$.
nodes.title: Hausdorff dimension of the Mandelbrot boundary (Shishikura)

nodes.summary: The Mandelbrot set, the set of all $c \in \mathbb{C}$ for which the sequence $(T_c^n(0))_{n \ge 0}$ of iterates of $0$ under $T_c(z) = z^2 + c$ is bounded, is a nonempty connected subset of $\mathbb{C}$.
nodes.title: The Mandelbrot set is connected (Douady–Hubbard)

nodes.summary: The Mandelbrot set is the set of all $c \in \mathbb{C}$ for which the orbit of $0$ under $T_c(z) = z^2 + c$ is bounded: there is a real number $M$ with $|T_c^n(0)| \le M$ for every $n \in \mathbb{N}$, where $T_c^n$ is the $n$-th iterate of $T_c$ and $T_c^0$ is the identity.
nodes.title: The Mandelbrot set

nodes.summary: For each complex number $c$, the map $T_c : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ is given by $T_c(z) = z^2 + c$.
nodes.title: Quadratic family

nodes.summary: For $c \in \mathbb{C}$, $T_c \colon \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ is the map $T_c(z) = z^2 + c$.
nodes.title: The quadratic family

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
